title: Fourth-order smooth approximation
statement: For every real $\eta>0$, every nonnegative real number $c$, and every $c$-Lipschitz function $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, there exists a function $\phi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ of class $C^4$ such that, for every real $x$, $|\phi(x)-\psi(x)|\le 4c\eta$ and $|\phi^{(4)}(x)|\le 8c/\eta^3$.
replaced: For every $\eta>0$, $c\ge0$, and $c$-Lipschitz function $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, there exists $\phi\in C^4(\mathbb R)$ such that $|\phi(x)-\psi(x)|\le4c\eta$ and $|\phi^{(4)}(x)|\le8c/\eta^3$ for all real $x$.
